blocks.content: In the first part of this interactive Java course, we learned the fundamental concepts of Java and programming in general. If these concepts below don't ring a bell for you, we suggest taking the Java Basics Course first.
However, if you are comfortable writing programs involving these topics, it's time to understand Java on a deeper level. That's what this course is about.
In this course, we will mainly focus on Object-oriented Programming (OOP).
After understanding these concepts, you will gain a better understanding of Java in terms of Object-oriented approach.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
